---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
top_sluggers <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    career_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_season = min(yearID),
    last_season = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_HR), playerID) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(
    People |>
      transmute(playerID, full_name = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " ")),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_season >= 1994 & first_season <= 2009,
      "Active 1994-2009",
      "Not active 1994-2009"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  top_sluggers,
  aes(x = career_HR, y = fct_reorder(full_name, career_HR), fill = steroid_era)
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Steroid-era activity",
    values = c(
      "Active 1994-2009" = "#D55E00",
      "Not active 1994-2009" = "#0072B2"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Career Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database; era defined as 1994-2009."
  )
```

## Barry Bonds by season

```{r}
bonds_by_season <- Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(bonds_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
